title: WIE AGM ’25 welcomes a new committee
excerpt: A review of the year, thanks to the outgoing committee and the introduction of the 2025/26 office bearers.
content:
The Annual General Meeting of the IEEE Women in Engineering Student Branch Affinity Group was held at the Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering.

The event included a review of past activities, appreciation of the outgoing committee, and the introduction of new office bearers. Speeches by Prof. Maheshi Dissanayake and Prof. Vijitha Herath highlighted the group’s achievements and inspired continued growth and excellence.
